mapper.select: select LPAD( cast( (COALESCE(MAX(cast(product_id as INTEGER)), 0) + 1) as VARCHAR ), 5, '0') from "interviewworks_schema"."products"
mapper.insert: insert into "interviewworks_schema"."products" (product_id, products_name, price, stock, description) values (#{product_id}, #{products_name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{description})
mapper.update:
update "interviewworks_schema"."products"
